findings.reason: a node dispatched on §13 would find the work done and its declared red log green, so the section either closes stale or produces a false evidence record.
findings.text: §13 asserts "Each test fails on the current code, which is its negative control", but its two required tests (`tests/test_session_host.py::test_the_host_removes_its_fifo_when_its_owner_exits`, `tests/test_session_host_plugin.py::test_a_signal_removes_its_fifo` and `::test_removes-its-fifo-when-its-owner-exits` — run as three) all pass on base 5137df573 ("3 passed in 3.63s"); the section has no negative control that can fail

findings.reason: §13 is carried as `implementable` while its code and tests are landed, so a dispatched node re-implements committed work; the only genuine remainder is the live `stale_fifos=0` census the folded plan's §9 stayed open for, which the section presents instead as a build.
findings.text: §13's deliverable and root cause describe FIFO removal as unbuilt, but the mechanism is already on the base tree: `_remove_fifo` is defined at `reckon/crew/session_host.py:566`, called from the stop path at `:558`, and the entry point installs signal handlers for `TERM`/`HUP` at `:688`; the fix landed in commit `68361d4ee` ("fix(crew): remove the session host FIFO when the host stops", 2026-10-07), an ancestor of base `5137df573`, and the source module docstring already claims "a session that ends leaves no stale FIFO"
